title: Lambda Prize | Logos
description: Lambda Prize rewards products built on the Logos stack that find real users. Explore open prizes, success criteria and rewarded solutions.

hero.title: Prize
hero.heading:
Launch something people use.
Get rewarded.
hero.body:
{mark} Prize rewards products built on the Logos stack that find real users,
whether you build them, reuse what exists, or both. No applications or
proposals necessary - just build the first solution that meets every
criterion to win.

featured.heading: Featured prizes
featured.body: Three prizes to start with. Every open prize is listed further down.

prizes.title: LEZ Wallet and Provider SDK
prizes.body:
A wallet for a single LEZ zone, with public and private
accounts and an SDK for third-party apps.

featured.body:
A wallet for a single LEZ zone, with public and private
accounts and an SDK for third-party apps.

prizes.title: Forum App
prizes.body:
A public forum with privacy at its core, for open discussion
without surveillance.

featured.body:
A public forum with privacy at its core, for open discussion
without surveillance.

prizes.title:
NFT Wallet Support and Private
Ownership Proof
prizes.body:
NFT support for the LEZ wallet, plus proof you hold an
NFT from a collection without revealing which one.

featured.body:
Prove you hold an NFT from a collection without revealing
which one.

prizes.title: LEZ Program Registry
prizes.body:
A registry that turns program IDs into named, searchable,
source-verified entries.

prizes.title: OpenStreetMap Integration
prizes.body:
Map data distributed through Logos Storage, with
integrity checks.

prizes.title:
Combined Blockchain and Zone
Wallet
prizes.body:
One wallet across the Logos blockchain and any number of
LEZ zones, with staking and bridging.

steps.title: Pick a prize.
steps.body:
Each prize lists what to build, the
success criteria, and the payout.

steps.title: Talk to users.
steps.body:
Find out what people would
actually use before you write
code.

steps.title: Plan and build.
steps.body:
Build or reuse. If something
already does the job, use it. You
may not need to build much, or
anything at all.

steps.title: Grow Adoption.
steps.body:
Every prize requires real
adoption. Release early so usage
grows from day one.

steps.title: Claim it.
steps.body:
Open a solution PR with
evidence for each criterion.

steps.title: Get paid.
steps.body:
The prize is paid in USDT when
the submission is picked as the
winner.

requirements.heading:
Real users and a
solution that works
for them.

cards.title: It's used.
cards.body:
Each prize lists the adoption it needs. The LEZ Program Registry
prize asks for:

metrics.label: programs registered by 20+ authors over two months
public testimonials on Discord and X

cards.title: It works.
cards.body:
Your product does what the prize asks, for the people using it.
Build it, reuse what exists, or combine the two. Evaluators check
it against every success criterion.

requirements.footnote: Manufactured volume doesn't count. Evaluators check account history and commit history.
requirements.mobileHeading:
Two gates.
Real users. A product
that works for them.

rules.heading: The Rules
rules.body: Five rules apply to every prize.

rows.title: First valid solution wins.
rows.body: Priority goes to the first solution PR that meets every criterion.

rows.title: Pass or fail.
rows.body:
Evaluation feedback is pass or fail. For detail, ask evaluators in
#builder-hub.

rows.title: Open source.
rows.body: Solutions ship under MIT and Apache 2.0.

rows.title: Open to anyone.
rows.body:
Any individual or team can enter. Logos contributors and their
contractors can't.

rows.title: Build in public.
rows.body: It's expected. Claiming someone else's in-progress work isn't.

openPrizes.heading: Open prizes
openPrizes.body: Five open now, one coming soon.

ownership.body:
Prizes grow the Logos applications and infrastructure others depend on,
and adoption is the key to sustainability.

After you win a prize, you keep your app, its users, and your place in the
growing Logos ecosystem.

nextRound.title: There's a next round.
nextRound.body:
Every open prize covers a first adoption tranche. Follow-up prizes with higher thresholds are
expected as the network grows. Ship the first version and you're first in line for the next.

resources.heading: Resources
resources.body:
Office hours, livestreams, and direct access to the ecosystem development team. Ask
questions in Discord or on the Logos Forum.

rfp.label: RFP Program
rfp.body: Need funding before you build? The RFP Program funds teams to build defined specs, paid per milestone.

mobile.title: Need funding before you build?
mobile.body: The RFP Program funds teams to build defined specs, paid per milestone.
